limits: Local component proof only; no hosted deployment or Registry publication.
Host restart includes verified task-owned native-child cleanup and a guarded second-instance port adapter.
No immediate invalidation of already-issued JWTs is claimed.
Private asset shelf: media URLs require authorized access; public text remains the authoritative claim map.
Publishing preserves original capture/source provenance; no new behavior or screenshots were generated.
